component.name: Moonglow
component.summary: External-display brightness and scheduled colour temperature

description.p: Moonglow drives external-monitor brightness over DDC/CI and follows a morning/evening colour-temperature schedule. It lives in the system tray with per-channel popups, scroll-to-adjust with on-screen feedback, a settings window, and a full command-line interface.
First stable Linux release: DDC/CI brightness, scheduled colour temperature, tray popups with scroll adjustment and OSD feedback, settings window, CLI, and autostart.
